description: Defines a React component 'TagDialog' used for creating or editing tags with name and color, providing UI for input and handling form submission.

methods.name: TagDialog
methods.description: React functional component for the tag dialog UI.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Handles closing the dialog, resetting disabled state and calling onClose callback.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, invokes onSubmit callback, disables the save button, and resets form fields.

methods.name: handleNewTagNameChange
methods.description: Updates state with the new tag name as user types.
